name: askbics-teams
description: Isolated askBICS Teams pilot; independent of the Power BI visual

scripts.build: node scripts/build-visual.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck app/visual-client.ts app/model-service.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && node dist/test/pilot.test.js && node dist/test/suggestions.test.js && node --test dist/test/connections.test.js dist/test/selected-model.test.js dist/test/remembered-session.test.js test/visual.test.mjs
